long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I have decided to read about the moon's colour, and the bookshelf is where that is done.
The moon's colour is a question I have not been told the answer to, and that is annoying in a useful way.
I will keep a picture of the telescope, since I claimed it first.
From up high I can see everything arriving on the island before anyone else does.
The sky is getting dark enough to be worth looking at, and the telescope is mine.
I will look at the moon through the telescope and see whether its colour matches what I have read.

today.reason: Food is unavailable until morning, so I will fill the afternoon with reading and high watching, then use the telescope once dusk arrives.
